args.final_thought:
Implemented GridForge in `/app`.

### Included
- Custom 100×26 spreadsheet grid with row/column headers and one transient cell editor
- Keyboard navigation, rectangular selection, copy/cut/paste/clear, Undo/Redo
- Fill Down/Right with numeric sequences and shifted formula references
- Formula engine supporting arithmetic, ranges, `SUM`, `AVG`, `MIN`, `MAX`, and `COUNT`
- Formula suggestions, click/drag reference insertion, circular/division/invalid feedback
- Find Next, Replace Current, Replace All, and name-box navigation
- SQLite persistence, autosave, manual save, revision history, preview, and restore-as-draft
- Seed-once startup behavior
- Session-bound user attribution and per-cell history
- Atomic save validation at the server trust boundary
- Different-cell concurrent merge and same-cell conflict rejection
- SSE live presence, independent view colors, selections, and remote revisions
- Responsive interface with visible dirty/saving/saved/failed/conflict states
- `APP_MANIFEST.md`, `.gitignore`, and working `npm start`

### Verification
Passed:
- JavaScript syntax checks
- API validation and rejection tests
- User/session mismatch rejection
- Atomic no-write behavior on invalid saves
- Concurrent different-cell merge
- Same-cell conflict rejection
- Cell attribution/history
- Unchanged-save revision deduplication
- Restart idempotence and committed-data reload
- Clean seed state: 1 workbook, 3 users, 1 revision, 0 changes

The app is currently running at `http://0.0.0.0:3000`.
